title: Disney accelerator brain-controlled rock 'Rocky'

tellings.quote: So, I worked with them and in the lab we invented a rock that you could move with your mind

plain: Eric Haseltine, a former official at the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that intercepts communications, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about earlier work with a Disney lab that helped young companies. He says that before 2020 they invented a rock, nicknamed Rocky, that a person could move with their mind.
